_meta.purpose: Story case: Redis OOM cascade causing auth login failures. Reproduces a real production incident (author's own experience — Redis bgsave failed under memory pressure, session writes rejected, users couldn't log in). Not a bgsave-specific fault — it's the general RES pattern where a downstream infra dep runs out of memory. Adding a Postgres out-of-connections case would be same pattern, different instance.
